assets.alt: Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze-teal, pearl-blue and copper, ruby-black, and emerald-silver and cobalt looks wear opaque stockings and pumps above Larvotto's pristine bay in Monaco.
Four fictional adult women in sharply short bronze, pale rose, turquoise-white, and plum-green RAZE looks share a warm harbor pose in four tall branded statement boots above Fontvieille in Monaco.

Four fictional adult women hold hands on Skopje's Vardar riverfront below the arched Stone Bridge and hilltop fortress, wearing sharply shortened crimson, gold, blue and green fashion looks with dark hosiery and heels.

Four fictional adult women stand together at a protected Matka Canyon overlook above the emerald reservoir, wearing sharply shortened red, rose-gold, green and blue looks with rainbow-gradient stockings and complete heels.
